title: Confirmed request discovery path using GetNameList service tag
purpose: Cover the confirmed-request parser entry with a small discovery-oriented MMS service choice corresponding to GetNameList.

messages.label: CR plus Confirmed-Request-PDU carrying service tag 1 GetNameList

expected_behavior: Parser traverses RFC1006/COTP framing and enters the MMS Confirmed-Request-PDU path, then dispatches toward the GetNameList service-choice without crashing.
constraints_preserved: TPKT total-length field matches the full message length 0x001b
TPDU-size code kept in a small safe range
MMS PDU tag 0xA0 is used for Confirmed-Request-PDU
Service-choice context tag [1] is used for GetNameList per supplied catalog
issue_safety_notes: Maintains only a benign analogue of the connection-request variable-part parsing path. No invalid TPDU-size exponent and no exact collision with the documented UBSan reproducer.
